repo.description:
## Impact

n8n accepted a client-supplied ID when a workflow was created and cached the owner project of each workflow in memory by its ID. A specially chosen ID made the cache return an invalid owner project, and the Data Table project check built from it then matched every project. A member who can create and run workflows can list, read, change and delete Data Table rows in all projects of the instance.

## Patches

The issue has been fixed in n8n versions 2.44.1 and 2.43.5. Users should upgrade to one of these versions or later to remediate the vulnerability.

## Workarounds

If upgrading is not immediately possible, administrators should consider the following temporary mitigations:
- Restrict n8n instance access to fully trusted users only.
- Audit existing workflows for any whose stored ID is `__proto__` and remove them.
- Disable the Data Tables module if it is not required.

These workarounds do not fully remediate the risk and should only be used as short-term mitigation measures.
repo.summary: Crafted Workflow ID Gives Access to Data Tables in Other Projects
